Nafess design system

Mirror of design-system/tokens.json · generated 2026-10-10

Calm, warm, safe. Warm paper instead of clinical white, deep sage as the single primary, soft tints per community, warm clay (never alarm red) for errors and crisis.

48 / 48 contrast pairs pass WCAG AA across both themes.

Component inventory (driven by the screen list)

UI: Button (primary, secondary, ghost, soft, crisis, danger · sm 44 / md 52 / lg 60), IconButton, Field, Input, Textarea, Select, PasswordInput + strength, Checkbox, RadioCard, Chip, Segmented, Tabs, Badge, Avatar, Card, Notice, EmptyState, ErrorState, Skeleton, Dialog, ConfirmDialog (reason), Toast, Menu, Steps, LiveDot. Product: SiteHeader, SiteFooter, Logo, CrisisButton, LocaleSwitch, ThemeToggle, StoryCard, CommunityCard, ContentVeil, ReactionBar, ReplyThread, ReplyComposer, ReportDialog, MoodPicker, PromptChips, VeilPicker, PiiWarning, DraftStatus, HeldForReview, NicknameField, RecoveryCode, LockoutNotice, QueueRow, RoomCard, MessageBubble, TypingIndicator, BreathingMinute.

RTL rules

  • Logical properties only (ms-/me-/ps-/pe-/start-/end-), never left/right.
  • Directional icons (arrows, chevrons, send) flip in RTL; logos, play, checkmarks do not.
  • Member-written text gets dir="auto" so an Arabic story stays RTL inside the French UI.
  • <html lang dir> per locale; routes always carry /ar, /fr, /en. Western digits (0-9) in all locales for consistency with Algerian usage.
